usageNotes: Creates a named IPSet on a specific VM's firewall, which can then be populated with CIDRs/IPs and referenced in firewall rules. Requires VM.Config.Network on the VM; the VM's firewall must be enabled for IPSets to take effect. The 'rename' parameter doubles as an update path — pass the same value for both 'name' and 'rename' to update only the comment on an existing IPSet.

examples.summary: Create an IPSet named 'trusted-mgmt' for a management VM

params.name: trusted-mgmt
params.comment: Trusted management IPs for SSH and RDP access

tips: IPSet names must start with a letter and may only contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (min 2, max 64 chars).
Creating an IPSet here only registers the set; populate it afterward using the IPSet entries endpoint before referencing it in any firewall rules.
Use the 'digest' parameter to guard against concurrent edits when scripting changes to a busy VM's firewall config.
This endpoint is VM-scoped; for cluster-wide shared IPSets use the cluster firewall IPSet endpoints instead.
